lang_en:
It was her turn to pick. I said no anyway.
She wanted Pahalgam. I wanted Gulmarg.
She said her turn, her call.
I said not if it's wrong.
December leave approved. Flights by Friday.
NakshIQ, December: Gulmarg is a go.
Ten out of ten.
Pahalgam is a skip. Four out of ten.
She went quiet. Then said fine.
She booked Gulmarg herself.
And took my next turn as payment.
Travel intelligence doesn't care whose turn it is.
NakshIQ.
lang_hi:
चुनने की बारी उसकी थी। मैंने फिर भी मना कर दिया।
उसे पहलगाम चाहिए था। मुझे गुलमर्ग।
उसने कहा, बारी मेरी, तो फ़ैसला भी मेरा।
मैंने कहा, फ़ैसला ग़लत हो तो नहीं।
दिसंबर की छुट्टी मंज़ूर थी। शुक्रवार तक फ़्लाइट बुक करनी थी।
NakshIQ पर दिसंबर: गुलमर्ग, गो।
दस में से दस।
पहलगाम, स्किप। दस में से चार।
वो चुप हो गई। फिर बोली, ठीक है।
गुलमर्ग उसने ख़ुद बुक किया।
और बदले में मेरी अगली बारी ले ली।
ट्रैवल इंटेलिजेंस को फ़र्क नहीं पड़ता कि बारी किसकी है।
NakshIQ.

cover.hook: It was her turn to pick. | I said *no* anyway.

shots: s1: Night, a small apartment living room. She sits cross-legged on the sofa with a laptop; he stands behind the sofa, arms folded, shaking his head. (covers lines 1-2)
s2: Close on her turning to face him, hand on her chest, firm; he leans on the sofa back, unmoved. (covers lines 3-4)
s3: He paces by the window, phone face down in his hand; she watches him, jaw set. (covers line 5)
s4: Both side by side on the sofa, faces lit by the laptop, its screen turned away from camera; his eyebrows lift, she goes still. (covers lines 6-8)
s5: Close on her: a long breath, a small nod, then she pulls the laptop onto her knees and types. (covers lines 9-10)
s6: She shuts the laptop, turns and taps his chest with a finger; he raises both hands in surrender, laughing. (covers lines 11-13)
